body.title: Remove the output-parsing path and run the live checks
body.summary: Once everything above is in, remove presentedPathOf, toolResult on the presented turn, the chat host's tool-result feed to the presenter and the end-of-turn opening of whatever became pending, along with the TurnState fields only they used and the tests that pinned them. Nothing in the chat reads a tool result to decide what to open. Then run the live check against the finished behaviour: a declared document opens in the review pane even when the workflow result was large. The Codex chat live check (a Codex turn that calls insrc_present opens the declared document) is deferred by the user to a follow-up, because the insrc MCP server is not registered in Codex; until it is run, the Codex mapper rests on the unit tests against the pinned real capture.
acceptanceChecks: presentedPathOf, toolResult and the end-of-turn guess no longer exist and nothing references them
A turn with no declaration opens nothing at its end, and a result carrying a pendingApproval block opens nothing
The chat, presenter and extension tests and the type check pass
The live check was run by the user and its result recorded as reported, not run by the gate; the Codex chat live check is deferred
